title: aristolochia barbata subsp. dictyantha
intro: Aristolochia barbata subsp. dictyantha, commonly known as Woolly Dutchman's Pipe, is a plant species in the Aristolochiaceae family, characterized by its unique, pipe-like flowers and woolly foliage. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which are said to aid in wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Aristolochia barbata subsp. dictyantha include aristolochic acids, which are known for their antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
